text: DSH 资料库（dsh-library）是面向 Web 客户端的 DSH 插件，为每个工作区管理本机项目文件。它在侧栏提供资料库管理界面，并在对话输入区提供当前会话的资料范围控制；主要功能包括创建和关联资料库、批量导入文件与文件夹、按名称或来源路径查找文件，以及将授权原文件按需作为附件交给会话。用户可管理文件的排除、恢复和回收状态，也可选择会话是否使用资料库。适合希望按项目整理本机资料、并在聊天时选择性参考文件的 DSH 用户。使用前需要设置本机存储目录，并在存储设置中单独同意会话按需使用原文件。

DSH Library (dsh-library) organizes local project files by workspace. Its web panel creates libraries and imports files or folders. Per conversation, users select libraries, find files by name or source path, and attach originals when needed. Setup requires a local folder and consent for file use.
想把不同工作区的项目文件分别放进本机资料库。
能不能一次导入一批文件和整个文件夹，并保留原件？
让 DSH 按工作区自动建立对应的项目资料库。

怎么按文件名或导入时的来源路径找到资料？
我想从资料库里排除不希望聊天引用的文件。
I want to keep each workspace's project documents in a separate local library.
Can I choose which project files a chat conversation may use?
DSH 资料库的功能「按工作区整理」：为工作区创建资料库，也可将现有资料库关联到工作区；新工作区可在运行时自动建立资料库。
DSH 资料库的功能「批量导入原件」：在管理页选择或拖入多个文件及文件夹，确认清单后复制到资料库；来源文件保留不变。
DSH 资料库的功能「会话资料范围」：在对话输入区切换通用或资料库模式，并为当前会话选择可参考的资料库。
DSH 资料库的功能「查找并提供文件」：会话可按文件名或来源路径查找授权范围内的文件，再按需将所选原件作为附件交付。
DSH 资料库的功能「整理和恢复文件」：管理页可排除文件、移入回收区并恢复，也能整理整个资料库中的文件。
DSH 资料库使用前须知：首次使用要先选择本机存储根目录并保存设置，之后才能创建资料库。
DSH 资料库使用前须知：资料范围选择不会自动允许交付原件，设置中还需单独同意按需使用。

dsh-library README · DSH 资料库 · 把项目资料带进对话：**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

给 **DeepSeek Harness** 的每个项目配一个资料库。文档、图片、表格或其他项目文件，都可以放在一起管理；聊天时开启资料库模式，让 AI 按需参考其中的原文件。

资料保存在你指定的本机目录，按工作区分开整理。你可以在「资料库」菜单里查看和管理所有库，也可以在对话中选择这次要用哪些资料。

text:
dsh-library README · 安装：当前正式版为 **1.0.1**，适配 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` 接口，声明兼容范围为 `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`，需要 Node.js ≥22.13.0。各宿主版本的验证情况见[验证记录](docs/validation.md)。

1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/wuzeno/dsh-library/releases/latest) 下载 **`dsh-library-1.0.1.tgz`** 插件安装包。
2. 打开 DSH 的「插件」管理器，通过本地安装包入口安装并启用。如果宿主提供的是链接本地目录入口，先解压安装包，再选择其中包含 `package.json` 的 `package` 目录。
3. 完整退出 DSH，包括托盘里的后台进程，再启动并刷新页面。侧栏出现「资料库」就可以开始使用了。

升级时保留现有资料，先备份资料目录和 DSH profile，再安装新版本并完整重启。

dsh-library README · 首次使用：1. **选好存储位置。** 打开「资料库 → 存储与隐私」，选择或填写运行 DSH 的电脑上的本机绝对路径，点击保存。
2. **确认文件使用授权。** 在同一页面确认是否允许模型按需使用整份原文件。
3. **放入项目资料。** 新工作区会自动建库；已有工作区可以先创建或关联资料库，再拖入文件或文件夹，核对清单并确认导入。
4. **开始提问。** 新建对话默认是通用模式。需要参考资料时，点击对话框里的资料范围入口，手动开启资料库模式，确认范围后直接描述你的问题。

例如，可以试着问：“项目里有哪些参考文档？”或“请根据库里的需求文档，整理这次要做的功能。”

text:
dsh-library README · 按需附件与隐私：资料先保存在本机，需要参考时，再由模型按授权范围打开相关原件。导入后即可管理文件，具体内容的读取由宿主、当前模型和可用工具完成；支持保存的格式与能够读取的格式有所区别。

使用云端模型时，打开文件可能将整份原件发送给模型，并留在会话附件和历史中。你可以关闭授权来停止后续交付；已经发送的内容仍保留在原会话中。请根据资料的敏感程度决定是否授权，存储目录也应放在 Git 仓库之外。

授权范围、附件交付和数据处理的详细说明见[使用细节与技术参考](docs/usage-reference.md#按需附件与隐私)及[安全说明](SECURITY.md)。

dsh-library README · 格式与边界：支持任意格式的原文件存储，文件夹可递归导入。单文件默认上限为 **50 MiB**，可在设置中调整为 **1–200 MiB**；每库最多 **2000 个文件**，包含回收区。

大批量导入、目录扫描和各类文件的使用方式，见[完整参数说明](docs/usage-reference.md#格式与边界)。
dsh-library README · 一键移入回收区：在资料库详情的「文件」页点击「全部移入回收区」，输入完整库名确认，即可把该库全部未回收文件移入回收区，包括已排除的文件。操作范围是整个库，与当前搜索或筛选无关；之后可以逐个恢复。
dsh-library README · 回收区永久删除：在「回收区」中，可以永久删除单个文件，也可以清空整个回收区。两种操作都会要求输入完整名称确认，确认后删除库内副本、释放对应空间。永久删除不可恢复，重要资料请先备份。

dsh-library README · 删除资料库：先停用资料库，再从详情页选择「删除资料库」。确认框会列出文件数量和本地目录，输入完整库名后，删除该库及其目录中的文件，来源文件夹里的原件保持原样。

删除中的异常处理与重试方式见[操作细节](docs/usage-reference.md#删除资料库)。

dsh-library README · 数据布局与备份：备份时，请同时保留**资料存储目录和 DSH profile**，这样才能保留原件以及资料库关联、授权等设置。修改存储根目录后，新建资料库会使用新位置，已有资料库继续保存在原处。

目录结构、元数据与恢复方式见[备份说明](docs/usage-reference.md#数据布局与备份)和[架构与恢复](docs/architecture.md)。

dsh-library README · 开发与发布：开发环境需要 Node.js 22.13+（建议 24 LTS）与 pnpm。

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm run test:all
pnpm pack --pack-destination release
```

参与开发可查看[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)、[发布清单](docs/releasing.md)和[验证记录](docs/validation.md)。实现细节另见[技术参考](docs/usage-reference.md#开发与发布)。

dsh-library README · 许可：本项目是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的非官方插件，不隶属于 DeepSeek。项目代码与原创书本图标采用 MIT 许可。

界面截图用于功能展示，其中第三方商标、主题背景和装饰素材归各自权利人所有。第三方依赖遵循各自许可证，详见[许可说明](docs/usage-reference.md#许可)。

Give every project in **DeepSeek Harness** its own library. Keep documents, images, spreadsheets, and other project files together, then turn on library mode in a conversation so AI can refer to the original files as needed.

Files stay in a local directory you choose, organized by workspace. Manage all your libraries from the Library menu, and choose which ones to use in each conversation.

dsh-library README · v1.0.1 update · General mode by default：**New conversations no longer enable library mode by default.** Chat normally, then open the library scope control and enable library mode when you want to reference project files.

Existing conversations keep their saved mode choices. Libraries, imported files, and storage locations stay unchanged; no re-import is needed. After updating, fully quit DSH (including its system-tray background process) and restart it so the new client and backend take effect together.

text: dsh-library README · Keep each project's files together：New workspaces get their own libraries automatically. For existing workspaces, create a library or link one you already have. The management page lets you find libraries by name, workspace, or storage path, and sort them by last updated, name, or file count.

dsh-library README · Choose where your files live：On first use, choose a local folder for library storage. Importing copies files into the library and leaves the originals in their source folder. Each library has its own directory, making storage and backups easier to organize.

dsh-library README · Import files and folders in batches：Store original files in any format. Select or drag in multiple files or entire folders, review the list in a dialog, and confirm the import. Follow progress and individual file results as they come in. Files with the same name are stored separately.
section: Import files and folders in batches

text: dsh-library README · Bring relevant files into the conversation：New conversations start in **general mode**, ready for everyday chat. When you want to reference project files, open the library scope control in the conversation and switch to library mode. AI can then find and open authorized originals. Library mode uses the current workspace's linked library by default, and you can authorize additional libraries for that conversation. Existing conversations keep their saved mode choices.
section: Bring relevant files into the conversation

text: dsh-library README · Decide which files AI can use：Include or exclude individual files from AI reference, download originals, or move files to the recovery area and restore them later. For larger cleanups, move a library's files to the recovery area in one action, empty the recovery area, or deactivate and delete a library. Permanent deletion requires you to type the name to confirm.
section: Decide which files AI can use

text: dsh-library README · Installation：The current stable release is **1.0.1**, targeting the DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` interface. The declared compatibility range is `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`, with Node.js ≥22.13.0 required. See the [validation notes](docs/validation.md) for host-version testing details.

dsh-library README · Installation：1. Download the **`dsh-library-1.0.1.tgz`** plugin package from [Releases](https://github.com/wuzeno/dsh-library/releases/latest).
2. Open the DSH plugin manager, install the local package, and enable it. If your host offers a local-directory linking option instead, extract the package and select the `package` folder containing `package.json`.
3. Fully quit DSH, including its background process in the system tray. Start it again and refresh the page. Look for **资料库** (Library) in the sidebar.
dsh-library README · Installation：When upgrading, keep your existing files. Back up both the library storage directory and your DSH profile, install the new version, and fully restart DSH.

dsh-library README · Getting started：1. **Choose a storage location.** Open **资料库 → 存储与隐私** (Library → Storage & Privacy), select or enter an absolute local path on the computer running DSH, and save it.
2. **Confirm file access.** On the same page, choose whether to allow the model to use complete original files on demand.
3. **Add your project files.** New workspaces get libraries automatically. For an existing workspace, create or link a library, drag in files or folders, review the list, and confirm.
4. **Ask a question.** New conversations start in general mode. To reference project files, open the library scope control, enable library mode, check which libraries are in scope, and describe what you need.

dsh-library README · Getting started：For example: “What reference documents are in this project?” or “Use the requirements document in the library to summarize the features we need to build.”

section: Set access for the current conversation

text: dsh-library README · On-demand attachments and privacy：Files are stored locally first. When needed, the model opens relevant originals within the scope you authorize. You can manage files as soon as they are imported; reading their contents depends on the host, current model, and available tools. A format that can be stored may not be readable by your current setup.

dsh-library README · On-demand attachments and privacy：When using a cloud model, opening a file may send the complete original to the model and retain it in conversation attachments and history. Turning off access stops future delivery; content already sent remains in the original conversation. Consider the sensitivity of your files before granting access, and keep your library storage directory outside Git repositories.

dsh-library README · On-demand attachments and privacy：For details on authorization, attachment delivery, and data handling, see the [technical reference](docs/usage-reference.md#按需附件与隐私) and [security notes](SECURITY.md).

dsh-library README · File formats and limits：Store original files in any format and import folders recursively. The default per-file limit is **50 MiB**, configurable from **1–200 MiB**. Each library holds up to **2,000 files**, including those in the recovery area.

See the [full limits and behavior](docs/usage-reference.md#格式与边界) for batch imports, folder scanning, and file handling.

dsh-library README · Move all files to the recovery area：In a library's **文件** (Files) tab, click **全部移入回收区** (Move all to recovery area) and enter the full library name to confirm. This moves all files that are not already in the recovery area, including excluded files. It applies to the whole library, regardless of the current search or filter. You can restore files individually afterward.
section: Move all files to the recovery area

text: dsh-library README · Permanently delete files from the recovery area：In **回收区** (Recovery area), permanently delete individual files or empty the entire recovery area. Both actions require the full name to confirm and delete the library's copies to free the corresponding disk space. Permanent deletion cannot be undone, so back up important files first.
section: Permanently delete files from the recovery area

text:
dsh-library README · Delete a library：Deactivate the library, then choose **删除资料库** (Delete library) on its detail page. The confirmation dialog shows the file count and local directory. Enter the full library name to delete the library and the files in its directory. Originals in the source folder stay untouched.

See the [operation details](docs/usage-reference.md#删除资料库) for error handling and retries.

dsh-library README · Storage and backups：Back up **both the library storage directory and your DSH profile** to preserve original files along with library links, permissions, and other settings. After you change the storage root, new libraries use the new location; existing libraries stay where they are.

See the [backup reference](docs/usage-reference.md#数据布局与备份) and [architecture and recovery notes](docs/architecture.md) for directory structure, metadata, and recovery details.

dsh-library README · Development and releases：Development requires Node.js 22.13+ (24 LTS recommended) and pnpm.

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm run test:all
pnpm pack --pack-destination release
```

See the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md), [release checklist](docs/releasing.md), and [validation notes](docs/validation.md). Implementation details are in the [technical reference](docs/usage-reference.md#开发与发布).

The linked supporting documents are currently in Chinese.
